targets.exact_proposed_header:
theorem convex_minimizer_comparison (V : Set E) (f h : E → ℝ) (p : E)
    (hp : p ∈ V) (hf : ConvexOn ℝ V f)
    (hmin : IsMinOn (fun z => f z + h z) V p)
    (h' : E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (hd : HasFDerivAt h h' p) :
    ∀ u ∈ V, f p - f u ≤ h' (u - p)

scoped_context: arbitrary real normed vector space; no completeness, finite dimension or inner product

semantic_slots.objects: V subset E; total real f,h; supplied p in V; continuous linear hprime
semantic_slots.quantifiers: V f h p hp hf hmin hprime hd, then every u in V; same p and objective
semantic_slots.regularity: f convex on V, h ambient Frechet differentiable at p only, actual minimization of f+h on V. No derivative of f or convexity of h.
semantic_slots.conclusion: f(p)-f(u) <= hprime(u-p), no existential minimizer or assumed regret/stability bound
semantic_slots.constants: no step size or normalization, no denominator; u=p and singleton sets allowed
semantic_slots.information: deterministic supplied minimizer; no algorithm/time/feedback or existence/uniqueness conclusion
semantic_slots.boundary: Real-valued comparison helper, not full extended-real/Bregman/recursive source theorem. Actual attainment and finitePart bridges remain required.
